consumer.use: Decide whether the terminally paper-passed S1-R2 sampling rule plus unchanged S0-R3 Outcome Case semantics can be applied prospectively to the first three real post-activation Operator-Intake births without source-selection, capture or authority failure.

decision_target.question: Can the unchanged S1-R2 canonical-identity/fixed-slot natural-source contract bind the first three real post-activation Bureau Operator-Intake births prospectively, with zero sampling/capture failures and acceptable handling cost?

intervention.name: prospective S1-R2 natural three-slot capture
intervention.description: After the exact reviewed base/head/canonical-PR-diff tuple is integrated into main with exact pre-merge PR identity and exact post-merge parent/tree identity plus a frozen five-minute cooling interval, normalize the complete authoritative Bureau candidate journal under unchanged S1-R2 sections 2-5, fix the first three post-activation Operator-Intake identity births by identity-first event id, apply source independence only as a gate on each fixed slot, and attempt read-only pre-mutation S0-R3 C/S/B/E/T/Q capture without delaying productive work.

control_condition.description: Exactly three already frozen S0-R3 paper-semantic controls used previously by S1: R3-02 create-then-mutate, R3-04 pure prerequisite then distinct transition, and R3-08 unresolved subject equivalence. They are semantic benchmarks only and never natural evidence.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly the first three canonical post-activation Operator-Intake identity births under unchanged S1-R2 sequence-before-naturalness semantics, permanently assigned to S1R2-N01, S1R2-N02 and S1R2-N03 without replacement or backfill.

measurement.method: Before merge, one independent read-only reviewer must be bound to the exact reviewed base, reviewed head and canonical GitHub PR diff digest and must verify the activation-specific boundary, imported frozen authorities, first-three sequence-before-naturalness, slot-consuming source gate, prospective capture/failure semantics and zero productive authority; every decision-bound review job must be terminal and reconciled. Immediately before merge the PR tip/base/canonical-diff tuple must still match that review. Only after the resulting main merge commit is proven to have exactly the reviewed base and reviewed head as its two parents, with the reviewed head as an ancestor and the merge tree exactly equal to the reviewed-head tree, plus the frozen five-minute cooling interval, for each of the first three fixed canonical slots establish or fail source independence from pre-existing evidence, then where still prospectively possible freeze C/S/B/E/T/Q before productive mutation/result knowledge without delaying work. After the terminal packet, one independent exact-revision reviewer reproduces activation, sequence, naturalness, capture timing and classifications.
measurement.success: Pre-activation base/head/canonical-PR-diff-bound review has zero material findings, every decision-bound review job is terminal/reconciled, pre-merge PR readback still matches the reviewed tuple, and the resulting main merge commit has exactly the reviewed base and reviewed head as its two parents with a tree exactly equal to the reviewed-head tree; then exactly three fixed slots are consumed in canonical order; source independence passes for all three; natural_source_binding_failure_count is zero; terminal material review disagreements, authority violations and replacements/backfills are zero; median capture effort is <=600 seconds; at least two slots are non-D0 with definitive complete C/S/B/E/T bindings.
measurement.falsification: Before activation, any material review finding, unreconciled or mismatched decision-bound review, imported-authority mismatch, changed PR tip/base/canonical diff after review, merge-parent mismatch, merge-tree mismatch, ancestry failure, descendant-tip substitution, squash/rebase/cherry-pick or unreviewed conflict-resolution content, activation/selection degree of freedom or productive-authority requirement rejects the activation attempt. After activation, any source-independence failure, missed/late/result-informed capture, non-D0 prospective C/S/B/E/T failure, changed slot identity/classification, sequence/backfill violation, authority violation, material terminal-review disagreement, or median effort >600 seconds rejects the revision.

cost_metric.method: Measure each slot from observer capture start to freeze/stop. Exclude productive implementation and reviewer runtime.

comparison.unit: frozen S0-R3 paper-semantic benchmark versus one fixed natural post-activation identity slot
comparability_constraints: control is exactly R3-02, R3-04 and R3-08 and never counts as natural evidence
treatment is exactly S1R2-N01..N03 fixed by canonical identity-first event order before naturalness
S1-R2 sections 2-5 are imported unchanged and identified by method SHA-256
S0-R3 C/S/B/E/T/Q semantics are imported unchanged and identified by protocol SHA-256
no source, repository, risk, outcome, capture or task state may select or replace a slot
the observer causes zero productive work effects

activation requires exact reviewed base/head/canonical-PR-diff identity before merge and exact reviewed-base/reviewed-head parent plus reviewed-head-tree identity after merge; ancestry, tree equality or PR MERGED state alone is insufficient
confounders: natural source-independence evidence may be unavailable even when an arrival is genuinely independent
the observer may first see a fixed slot only after productive mutation naturally began
three slots may be dominated by D0 or otherwise low-information cases
the tiny sample estimates handling feasibility only, not Outcome Case efficacy or prevalence

independently produced source observation/request references that pre-exist experiment capture
Git/GitHub exact reviewed PR base/head/canonical diff, merge timestamp, resulting main merge parents/tree and ancestry truth
